scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Application Gateway 操作场景：创建 → 查询 → 探测查看 → 停止 → 启动 → 删除
commands: az network application-gateway create --name test-gateway --resource-group test-rg --capacity 2 --sku Standard_v2
az network application-gateway show --name test-gateway --resource-group test-rg
az network application-gateway probe show --gateway-name test-gateway --resource-group test-rg --name health-probe
az network application-gateway stop --name test-gateway --resource-group test-rg
az network application-gateway start --name test-gateway --resource-group test-rg
az network application-gateway delete --name test-gateway --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：网关创建成功但启动失败（后端池不健康）
commands: az network application-gateway create --name fail-gateway --resource-group test-rg --capacity 1 --sku Standard_v2
az network application-gateway start --name fail-gateway --resource-group test-rg

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：Application Gateway 不存在
commands: az network application-gateway show --name nonexistent-gateway --resource-group test-rg
